name: Olivia Scriven
bio:
Olivia Scriven (born 28 February 1997) is a Canadian actress who is most famous for portraying Maya Matlin on Degrassi: The Next Generation and Degrassi: Next Class.

She is currently half of the musical duo Cute Whore alongside Degrassi co-star Lyle Lettau.
